(() => { const img = document.querySelector('.region-img img'); if (!img) return 'no img'; const r = img.getBoundingClientRect(); img.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.left + r.width * 0.5, clientY: r.top + r.height * 0.5 })); return 'clicked ' + Math.round(r.width) + ' ' + (document.querySelector('.modal .progress span')?.textContent ?? 'ready'); })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelectorAll('.modal select')[0]; const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(sel, 'glow'); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.modal button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Add animation')); b.click(); return 'saved ' + !b.disabled; })()
